Description: Keybind (default K) plus a /titles command
Detail: Command matters for servers where keybinds conflict

Description: Left: scrollable grid of title cards. Right: detail panel for the selected title.
Detail: Grid of 4 columns fits a standard 176px-wide GUI poorly - build a wider custom screen around 256x220

Description: Name in rarity color plus a small rarity pip and an equipped indicator
Detail: Locked cards are grayed. Secret unearned cards show ??? only

Description: Full name - rarity - scarcity - flavor text - bulleted effect list with exact numbers
Detail: Show real numbers not vague words. LitRPG players want the stat block

Description: Generated from the effect data not hand-written strings
Detail: One display formatter per effect type. Otherwise your tooltips drift from the code

Description: 10 slots in two rows of 5. Drag or click to equip.
Detail: Equipping is a server round trip - never apply optimistically on the client

Description: Prominent "31 / 40" readout beside the slots that updates as you hover a candidate title
Detail: Show the projected total on hover before the player commits. Over-budget candidates render red and refuse the equip.

Description: Separate always-on row below the 10 slots for Unique and Limited titles
Detail: Visually distinct - these are not equipped and cannot be unequipped. Label it so nobody thinks they are wasting slots.

Description: When a cap is hit show the contributing effect struck through with "capped"
Detail: Otherwise players stack two damage titles and quietly get nothing for the second

Description: For unearned non-secret titles show current/required
Detail: Requires syncing progress counters to the client - throttle to once a second while the screen is open

Description: Tabs or dropdown by category plus toggles for Earned / Unearned / Secret
Detail: Becomes essential past about 30 titles

Description: Filter by name and effect keyword
Detail: Cheap to add and very appreciated

Description: By rarity - category - recently earned
Detail: P2

Description: For Limited and Founding titles show "2 of 3 claimed" and who holds them
Detail: Needs a synced server ledger snapshot. Big driver of the prestige feeling. Suppressed for secret titles until first claim - see the row below

Description: DECIDED - a secret title with a limited number of holders stays fully hidden until the FIRST player claims it. That claim broadcasts server-wide and permanently reveals the title - name - hint - holder roster and remaining slots - to everyone. The remaining slots then become a public race.
Detail: Resolves the collision between "secret shows ??? " and "scarce shows 2 of 3 claimed" - you cannot do both before the reveal or the counter leaks the secret. Reveal is a one-way flag on the ledger entry - not per-player - so everyone sees the same state. Currently applies to Monster Slayer (Founding 10) and Pacifist (Limited 3).

Description: Toast plus a sound plus an optional server broadcast for Legendary and above
Detail: Reuse the vanilla advancement toast style so it feels native. For a secret scarce title the FIRST claim always broadcasts regardless of rarity - that broadcast is what performs the reveal

Description: Optional per-title hint string revealed after partial progress
Detail: Keeps secret titles discoverable rather than wiki-only

Description: Optional small equipped-title display near the hotbar
Detail: Client config for position and visibility

Description: Show the primary equipped title above the player and before chat messages
Detail: Very popular in multiplayer. Make it toggleable - some servers hate it

Description: Never encode meaning in color alone - the rarity pip shape and the text label carry it too
Detail: Also respect the vanilla GUI scale and narrator

Description: Server sends the full title state on join and deltas on change. Client never computes eligibility.
Detail: Payload stays small if you send ids not full definitions - the client already has the registry from the datapack sync
